title: Jagged Squid Tacos
description: A spicy and tangy twist on traditional seafood tacos, featuring jagged squid as the main ingredient. Perfect for a quick and satisfying dinner.
instructions: Rinse the squid under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Cut the squid into small pieces and place in a bowl.
Drizzle lime juice over the squid and sprinkle with cumin and cayenne pepper. Toss to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the squid to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the squid onto a tortilla, followed by diced avocado and chopped cilantro.
